title: Booking Lead Rates for Premium Economy Upgrades
content:
**Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — how far ahead the ticket was bought.** The Premium Economy upgrade price is multiplied by the **booking lead rate**, which follows the whole days from the ticket's issue to the ticket's first flight. The rate acts on the unrounded price; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

## The days counted

Whole calendar days from the ticket's issue date to the date of the ticket's first flight. The first flight is the flight date recorded on the flown coupon of segment 1 when that coupon has been flown, and otherwise the ticket's next scheduled departure.

## The rate

| Whole days from issue to the first flight | Booking lead rate |
|---|---|
| 21 or more (long lead) | 0.95 |
| At least 7 (short lead) and fewer than 21 | 0.98 |
| Fewer than 7 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, ticket issued 1 July)

| First flight | Days | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 22 July | 21 | 0.95 |
| 21 July | 20 | 0.98 |
| 8 July | 7 | 0.98 |
| 7 July | 6 | 1 |
